title: ModuleManifest
description: Describes every optional/core module of the boilerplate. The `scripts/modules.mjs` script reads this file to validate (`check`) and prune (`apply`) a selection.

name.description: Unique module identifier, used in marker comments (`@module:<name>`).

kind.description: core = always present; optional = removable; db = exactly one per app.

group.description: Logical group. `db` modules are mutually exclusive and exactly one must be selected.

default.description: Whether the module is selected by default (used by `apply` when no selection is passed).

paths.description: Files/directories deleted when the module is removed. Relative to the repo root.

markers.description: Files that contain `@module:<name>` … `@end-module:<name>` regions for this module.

deps.description: npm deps removed from each workspace's package.json when the module is pruned. Keys are workspace names (package.json `name`).

env.description: Environment variable names owned by this module.

compose.description: Docker compose services owned by this module.

docs.description: Doc files that reference this module (informational, never pruned).

requires.description: Module names or group constraints this module requires (e.g. `group:db` means any db-group module).

conflicts.description: Module names this module cannot coexist with.

packageScripts.description: Scripts removed from each workspace's package.json `scripts` when the module is pruned. Keys are workspace names.

packageExports.description: Subpath exports removed from each workspace's package.json `exports` when the module is pruned. Keys are workspace names.
